ActorFrame.InitCommand: %function(self) SplatManiaSongNames = { {'15', 'HOME', {0,0.5,1} }, -- The following are for testing, and are not in the actual game. {'300MB', 'Neil Cicierega', {1,1,0.5} }, {'Critical Error', 'StrobeFlux', {1,0,0.5} }, {'NEONアーキテクチャ (パート2)', 'death\'s dynamic shroud.wmv', {0.7,1,0.7} }, } end

Layer.UpdateCommand: %function(self) self:x(20) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) local song = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong(); self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayMainTitle()) if string.len( string.sub(song:GetDisplayFullTitle(), string.len(song:GetDisplayMainTitle()) + 1) ) > 0 then self:zoom(0.4) self:y(20) else self:y(30) self:zoom(.5) end for i=1,table.getn(SplatManiaSongNames) do if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayMainTitle() == SplatManiaSongNames[i][1] then self:diffuse( SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][1],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][2],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][3],0 ) end end else self:hidden(1) end self:decelerate(0.1) self:x(10) self:diffusealpha(1) end

%function(self) self:x(20) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) local song = GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong(); self:settext( string.sub(song:GetDisplayFullTitle(), string.len(song:GetDisplayMainTitle()) + 1) ) if string.len( string.sub(song:GetDisplayFullTitle(), string.len(song:GetDisplayMainTitle()) + 1) ) > 0 then self:zoom(0.4) self:y(32) else self:y(30) self:zoom(.5) end for i=1,table.getn(SplatManiaSongNames) do if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayMainTitle() == SplatManiaSongNames[i][1] then self:diffuse( SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][1],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][2],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][3],0 ) end end else self:hidden(1) end self:decelerate(0.1) self:x(10) self:diffusealpha(1) end

%function(self) self:x(20) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist()) self:decelerate(0.1) for i=1,table.getn(SplatManiaSongNames) do if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist() == SplatManiaSongNames[i][2] then self:diffuse( SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][1],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][2],SplatManiaSongNames[i][3][3],0 ) end end else self:hidden(1) end self:x(10) self:diffusealpha(1) end

%function(self) self:zoom(0.18) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) if PROFILEMAN:GetMachineProfile():GetSongNumTimesPlayed(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong()) > 0 then self:settext( THEME:GetMetric('PaneDisplay', 'Played')..PROFILEMAN:GetMachineProfile():GetSongNumTimesPlayed(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong()) ) else self:settext( THEME:GetMetric('PaneDisplay', 'NeverPlayed') ) self:diffusetopedge(1,0,1,1) self:diffusebottomedge(0,1,1,1) end self:decelerate(0.1) else self:hidden(1) end self:zoom(0.3) self:diffusealpha(1) end

%function(self) MESSAGEMAN:Broadcast('UpdateSortOrder') self:y(30) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong() then self:hidden(0) self:diffuse(1,1,1,0) self:settext(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():GetDisplayArtist()) self:decelerate(0.1) if GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds() >= 3600 then self:settext(SecondsToHHMMSS(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds())) else self:settext(SecondsToMMSS(GAMESTATE:GetCurrentSong():MusicLengthSeconds())) end else self:hidden(1) end self:y(20) self:diffusealpha(1) end
